rules: One isolated bad event has limited long-term effect unless severe.
Repeated behavior may form a stable observed routine.
One positive activity does not instantly erase accumulated strain.
Character preferences modify the recovery value of leisure/social activities.
Positive balance maintains normal capacity rather than creating superhuman bonuses.
Derived state never changes authoritative world truth.
Derived state never forces player dialogue or moral choices.
Individual physiology/preferences are consumed from explicit character wellbeing profiles rather than inferred from species_id.
Academy Step 13 may derive wellbeing snapshots but formal obligation/academic/disciplinary consequences remain separate.
